title: ::: PSS-OFF 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ Passoff Reading 128 ]

blocks.text: The e-business industry is faced with a labor shortage. Experts point out that this is a serious problem that could slow down the development of our economy. Industries are competitively changing their businesses into e-businesses, and thus the demand for the required workforce is expected to grow. A recent survey shows that there is a gap between the labor supply and demand in the e-business industry. This is not likely to change before 2005.
